purpose: Determine whether DFPI, UBCKNN or FCA can supply fresh observed investment-artifact text under the sanitized text-only protocol without network access.

source_assessments.binding_limit: Complaint narratives are unverified reports and are not authorized as model input.
source_assessments.safe_future_intake: User-supplied first-party TXT/CSV/JSON/JSONL or explicit official export may enter evidence QA only.

source_assessments.binding_limit: An official warning page is evidence and is not the separate solicitation artifact to be predicted.
source_assessments.safe_future_intake: An official text export with a retained reuse basis may enter evidence QA only.

source_assessments.binding_limit: Warning-list membership or warning narrative cannot substitute for observed solicitation content or create a content label.
source_assessments.safe_future_intake: A first-party text export may enter evidence QA only; abandoned archived HTML derivatives remain excluded.

findings.root_cause: The three prioritized sources provide regulator or complaint evidence, not a distinct observed POST, MESSAGE or WEBSITE_SNAPSHOT artifact in an allowed inert text format.

next_source_requirements: contains observed investment-related post, message or website-copy text rather than registry prose alone
has record-level provenance and stable source identifiers
supports evidence review without visiting candidate live domains
keeps confirmed and legitimate evidence independent from the text artifact
can be grouped for leakage control before any split
